passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster led music in worship.
This psalm is a song for worship.

passages.text: How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
David speaks to the LORD.
He asks, “How long, O LORD?”
He asks, “Will You forget me forever?”
He asks, “How long will You hide Your face from me?”
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ עַד־ אָ֣נָה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד־ אָ֓נָה׀ תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת־ פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David feels deep distress.
David asks God a question.
David says, “How long must I struggle within myself?”
David feels sorrow in his heart every day.
David asks, “How long will my enemy rise above me?”
David feels overwhelmed by his enemy’s power.
passages.original: עַד־ אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד־ אָ֓נָה׀ יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death, lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD, his God.
David asks God to look at him.
David asks God to answer him.
David asks God to give light to his eyes.
David fears he will die if God does not help him.
David fears his enemy will say, "I have overcome him."
David fears his foes will rejoice when he falls.
passages.original: הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן־ אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת׃ פֶּן־ יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכָלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
passages.sermon: David speaks to God.\r\nDavid trusts in God's loving devotion.\r\nDavid's heart rejoices in God's salvation.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ

passages.text: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David says, "I will sing to the LORD."
The LORD has been good to me.
The LORD has shown me kindness.
Because of this, I will praise Him with my song.
